digest.component_or_area: rebar code-review project-criterion runtime seam and phase-boundary criterion
propositions: The code-review extension seam is incomplete: activated net-new project criteria are not dynamically fanned into Pass 1, resolved by the eval/CLI surface, or consulted through repository-aware Pass-3 routing.

A generic bug repair maps logical project.<name> ids to validator-safe physical code-review-project-<name> ids with no special case for the phase-boundary criterion, keeping routing JSON keyed by the logical id.

A single project criterion project.review-phase-boundaries enforces the four-phase contract (discover, assess, decide, coach) and flags cross-phase drift such as moving severity, disposition, or remediation into the wrong phase.
The criterion ships advisory-only with block_threshold 0.90 and blocking_enabled false, requiring a balanced RP-F1..RP-F6 / RP-N1..RP-N6 eval corpus and live Gerrit dogfood evidence.
Overlay-absent repositories must preserve their pre-change results and be pinned by compatibility tests when the generic seam changes.
The epic is closed as superseded by umbrella epic 119f-63e3-34b7-4f96, force-closed without completion/signature attestation, with scope carried forward there.
